expectations.text: Produces a structured audit report BEFORE making code changes
expectations.evidence: The audit-report.md has a clear structure: 'Audit Summary' with severity-grouped issues, then 'Changes Made' tables per file, then 'Data Flow Verification', 'Performance Impact', and 'Remaining Issues'. The report structure implies audit-first workflow. Without a transcript, ordering cannot be definitively confirmed.

expectations.text: Identifies the URL overflow in the _detailCard function or the 'Analyzed domain' card
expectations.evidence: The report identifies URL overflow broadly: Critical issue 'URL overflow breaking card containers on mobile (links.js: orphan URLs, hub URLs, spoke tags, backlink URLs)'. Changes section shows: 'Detail card values: changed to overflow-wrap: anywhere' and 'Detail card values: changed to text-xl sm:text-2xl for responsive sizing'. While '_detailCard' is not named explicitly, the detail card values are addressed directly.

expectations.text: Adds word-break: break-all or overflow-wrap: break-word for long URL display
expectations.evidence: links.js output shows multiple instances: line 96 has 'overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all', line 170 has 'overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all', lines 382-383 have 'overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all', line 683 has 'overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all'. CSS adds '.url-cell' class and '.report-table td { max-width: 300px; overflow-wrap: anywhere }'. report-styles.css also adds overflow-wrap to table cells.

expectations.text: Identifies at least 2 additional responsive issues beyond the reported URL overflow
expectations.evidence: Beyond the URL overflow (Critical), the report identifies: (1) 'Spoke/unreachable URL inline tags use break-all on inline-flex which behaves inconsistently' (Medium), (2) 'maximum-scale=1 equivalent not present' improved to maximum-scale=5.0 (Low), (3) CSS @import serializing font loading (High), (4) Synchronous scripts blocking rendering (High), (5) No preconnect hints (High). Additional responsive fixes in links.js: detail card responsive font sizing (text-xl sm:text-2xl), responsive padding changes throughout.

expectations.text: Preserves all link graph rendering functions (renderLinkOverview, renderOrphanPages, renderHubSpokeClusters, renderLinkDepth, renderBacklinkProfile)
expectations.evidence: Grep of links.js confirms all 5 functions present: renderLinkOverview (lines 16,23,751), renderOrphanPages (lines 17,77,752), renderHubSpokeClusters (lines 18,128,753), renderLinkDepth (lines 19,214,754), renderBacklinkProfile (lines 20,300,755). All are defined, called in init(), and exported.

expectations.text: Checks touch target sizing on interactive elements
expectations.evidence: Audit report CSS changes table: 'Added min-height/min-width: 28px to .severity-badge | Accessibility: improves touch target size'. While 28px is below the typical 44px/48px recommendation, the report explicitly addresses touch target sizing on interactive elements.

expectations.text: Includes performance findings (script loading, image optimization, or similar)
expectations.evidence: Multiple performance findings: (1) 'CSS @import for Google Fonts serializes font loading (report-styles.css:7)' -- High severity, (2) 'Synchronous <script> tags in <head> block rendering (links.html:8-9)' -- High severity, (3) 'No preconnect hints for third-party origins (links.html)' -- High severity. Performance Impact table shows FCP improvement estimates of ~200-400ms. Changes include moving fonts to HTML <link>, adding defer to scripts, adding 4 preconnect hints.

expectations.text: Does not remove or rename DOM elements targeted by getElementById (linkstats-content, orphans-content, etc.)
expectations.evidence: links.html preserves all 5 DOM IDs: linkstats-content (line 66), orphans-content (line 75), hubs-content (line 84), depth-content (line 93), backlinks-content (line 102). Audit report explicitly verifies: 'All dynamic content injection targets verified intact' with getElementById references for each.

claims.claim: Found 16 issues: 1 critical, 4 high, 7 medium, 4 low
claims.evidence: Counted: Critical has 1 item, High has 4 items, Medium has 7 items, Low has 4 items. Total = 16. Verified.

claims.claim: window.AUDIT_DATA injection on line 27 is preserved exactly
claims.evidence: The data-loader.js is confirmed unchanged, and the HTML preserves all data injection patterns.
Performance estimates cannot be verified without runtime testing. The claim is reasonable given the change from CSS @import to HTML link with preconnect, but the specific ms savings are estimates.

suggestions.assertion: Checks touch target sizing on interactive elements
suggestions.reason: This assertion passes even though the report only addressed severity-badge sizing at 28px (below the 44px/48px recommended minimum). A stricter assertion might check whether touch targets meet the 44px minimum per WCAG/Apple HIG guidelines.

eval_feedback.overall: Solid assertion set. All assertions are discriminating and meaningful.
